targets.expr:
sum(sum_over_time(
  {user_unit="coinbase-trader-ws.service"} 
  | regexp `fees=\$(?P<fee_str>[0-9,.]+)`
  | line_format `{{ .fee_str | replace "," "" }}`
  | regexp `(?P<fee>[-+]?[0-9.]+)`
  | unwrap fee [$__range]
))

sum(sum_over_time(
  {user_unit="coinbase-trader-ws.service"} 
  | regexp `PnL: \$(?P<pnl_str>[-+]?[0-9,.]+) \(entry=`
  | line_format `{{ .pnl_str | replace "," "" }}`
  | regexp `(?P<pnl>[-+]?[0-9.]+)`
  | unwrap pnl [$__range]
))

sum(sum_over_time(
  {user_unit="coinbase-trader-ws.service"} 
  | regexp `fees=\$(?P<fee_str>[0-9,.]+)`
  | line_format `{{ .fee_str | replace "," "" }}`
  | regexp `(?P<fee>[-+]?[0-9.]+)`
  | unwrap fee [1d]
))

sum(sum_over_time(
  {user_unit="coinbase-trader-ws.service"} 
  | regexp `PnL: \$(?P<pnl_str>[-+]?[0-9,.]+) \(entry=`
  | line_format `{{ .pnl_str | replace "," "" }}`
  | regexp `(?P<pnl>[-+]?[0-9.]+)`
  | unwrap pnl [1d]
))
